title: Act of Love
text:
O my God, because You are infinite goodness and worthy of infinite love,
I love You with my whole heart above all things,
and for love of You I love my neighbor as myself.
I forgive all who have offended me and ask pardon of all whom I have offended.
Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
